content:
Speed and Performance Improvements

OpenAI has released a new update for its image generation model, ChatGPT Images. Thanks to these technical improvements, the model is reported to run up to four times faster than previous versions. This performance boost aims to increase efficiency, particularly in scenarios requiring rapid concept development and near-real-time image generation.

Advanced Editing and Consistency

The update focuses not only on creating images from scratch but also on the ability to manipulate existing images. The new infrastructure minimizes the “loss of control” issue by preserving context during successive edits on an image. While lighting, composition, and fundamental details remain fixed, changes are applied only to the desired areas.

The model’s core technical capabilities include:

  • Adding, removing, and merging elements within an image.
  • Changing the position of existing objects.
  • High accuracy in changes to clothing, style, and atmosphere.
  • Access via the API with the GPT Image 1.5 release.

While the update is being rolled out globally, it was announced that full access for Business and Enterprise users will be provided at a later date.
